horoscopes.horoscope: If you’re looking to get married, buy the ring today. But before you take the leap, weigh all the pros and cons carefully, says Ganesha. All in all, this may be a day filled with activities related to your relationship and by the time the day ends, you may be on cloud nine!. You will be in a hurry while doing domestic activities with your sweetheart. You feel you need to attract your beloved so that you will have a fantastic evening. You may feel happy teasing your romantic partner and want to share a dream night together. On this lively day, you shall be full of beans. Spend your time to review your strategies and help others. Chalk out a fitness plan and follow it seriously. Do physical activities to boost your stamina, and remain in good shape. It may not be a very favourable day as far as earnings are concerned. But, working sincerely will help generate good money. Ganesha advises you against long term investments. Your superior feels that you are the right person to finish all the tasks and therefore give you the responsibilities. The day brings new projects for you at the work front, since your energy is just about right to take up initiatives, reveals Ganesha.

Today is a perfect day to relax and enjoy your health, feels Ganesha. However, precaution should be the buzzword while dealing in money matters. You may develop a new interest in jewellers, artists, bankers and orators. Dinner will be laced with all the deserving delicacies of a hearty meal. You should breathe a fresh air since there is no hassle foreseen at the love front. Your romantic life will play an important role today as you are likely to think for your future. You will feel safe and secured in the arms of your sweetheart, says Ganesha. Ganesha foresees that you may be prone to mood swings today. You could be pulled in different directions that may prevent you from working efficiently. This is also the right time to get rid of your bad habits and start meditation to remain calm. Since you are too insecure about financial planning, you would do well to seek the help of other people’s, but ensure that they are your well-wishers. You may plan a long-distance trip. Today, you are just not in the right mood to make more efforts. You are likely to feel tired or bored. Challenges will come your way, foresees Ganesha and you need to be prepared to take responsibilities. It will be better for you in the long run if you face challenges now.

It is a good day for you to participate in cultural events and group activities, predicts Ganesha. You are likely to be an important part of some convention or joint venture, but don’t get too bogged down by it. In the evening, you may take a fancy to fine arts, such as drawing or classical music. Compromise is the keyword in your love life. When you learn to sacrifice, everything will get changed. You are still immature in the minds of your partner. Your acts may not sound serious to your soulmate. You will better relate to your sweetheart once you are ready to learn his/her lifestyle. You will spend more time and energy in building and maintaining new relations. There will be a strong desire to do something new by expanding your circle. You will also gather more information about things and travel out for the same. You may suddenly feel like taking an initiative to make a friend feel happy, such as treating them to a movie. Well, your cheerfulness will rarely be off but Ganesha advises you not to expect much in return. A good day to schedule maintenance activities. This is the time you need to be alert while coordinating all your activities. You need to focus on pending works. Multitasking will help you perform better in the workplace, feels Ganesha.

Today, your ability to think clearly in the most adverse conditions will be your key weapon as you get cornered by unrelenting assaults of work and deadlines. The clarity will reflect in your work as you deal with inhuman work pressure. Your mind will save the day for you as well as your peers. You need to manage your stress. It would be safer if you avoid being selfish with your sweetheart. You are advised to stay away from getting into furious discussions with your beloved. After all, you won’t be happy and you may lose a crucial affair, reminds Ganesha. On this busy day, you may have to run around from pillar to post in order to simultaneously work on many fronts. Yet, you shall not get exhausted, because you are bound to succeed in everything you do today, says Ganesha. Today is so-so on the financial front for you. You need to think of how to improve your investment portfolio by committing to small but regular contributions which will not be too taxing. Precision will be in your mind whenever it comes to performing your tasks today. Ganesha feels that you should embrace new responsibility as a chance to move ahead. Your intuitive mind may be able to lessen complexities of the project. Career-related issues may occupy you for a while, reveals Ganesha.

You sure love playing a team sport, but that does not diminish the fact that you are a tough player to compete with, says Ganesha. If only they had a rugby team at the local club! You derive a sense of completion from the fact that you have given your best effort to any endeavour. You take on challenges with a nonchalant air of ‘come as they may’. With your attitude and strategy, success is not far behind. Smile along with Lady Luck by your side today, says Ganesha. Tonight you want to spend the time with your soulmate in a peaceful place. Candlelit dinner would not be a bad idea to bring that romance back in your life. Commitment, compassion, and creativity- these are some sought-after qualities you are expecting from your life partner. It is the time to use your time and energy fruitfully. If you use it for the right tasks, it will help you. However, if you get angry you may lose lot of energy. It is the ideal time for going on biking or some excursions. Foreign connections may give you good ideas or good clients. Gains from distant places can really enthuse you. There are all chances of earning a good sum with the help of people in authority and power. Your original ideas will play a key role in defining success. You are even likely to receive appreciation from your superiors for the jobs well executed. You will feel that you have recently achieved an important status in the workplace, reveals Ganesha.

All the work done in the past will reap rich rewards today, says Ganesha. You’ll direct things your own way, and in no way would you take orders from anyone. But don’t go overboard with all the authority and keep a cool, calm head. After a hard day, you will like to be alone. It’s sweet to dim the lights and relax with a soothing number on your iPod, feels Ganesha. However, spending a romantic time with sweetheart at the home spa will be sweeter, feels Ganesha. You need to take proper sleep and even ‘power naps’ as the day may drain you easily. You need to take health food. The day will also be more demanding at work. Don’t undertake sports activities or any laborius work. You may also feel that your efforts to earn money are going in vain. However, Ganesha feels that this is a psssing phenomenon. You should not be shaken up by things going wrong today. Pending tasks seem to get finished on time and your computer is expected to get loaded with responsibilities. More complex and critical tasks are coming your way. You are likely to turn more analytical. Patience should be the keyword. However, you will focus more on perfection, feels Ganesha.

Nothing overshadows your love for your children today. And love is precisely what drives you incessantly to give them the best possible of everything. Be it special classes for that extra edge in education, or a visit to a holy place to seek divine blessing, you will do it all today. And spending time with children isn’t all — you may end up taking a small but sweet trip in the evening, says Ganesha. You cannot imagine this beautiful evening without your sweetheart. You are likely to tease and caress your beloved. An intimate evening with your darling is on the cards, foresees Ganesha. You need to remain awake until midnight. Otherwise, you may fall asleep in the arms of your sweetheart. This is a good day to interact with knowledgeable persons to figure out what’s good for your health. You can also ask doctor’s advise, you will be guided properly. Time is not good to start gym but you can do Yoga or other spiritual activities. Ganesha feels that you may spend money to maintain your public image. Avoid ‘big show off’ as it will require ‘big money’ too. It’s very average day for financial success, so avoid taking big risks today. A perfect day of the month calls upon you to improve your relations with people at your workplace. Technical guys will keep themselves busy solving permutations and combinations. You need to be practical while taking up important projects, suggests Ganesha. Productivity will be good at the end of the day.

The day does not begin on a very good note as you seem to be in a belligerent mood. Be calm and patient as your hot temper may spoil a good deal. Limit your conversations and discussions with colleagues and friends, advises Ganesha. Practising meditation and yoga will bring you some respite towards the end of the day. You may be fascinated with some lovely gifts that you are planning to present to your loved one. You will like to amuse your partner, feels Ganesha. You both will eventually spend a wonderful time together sharing some amazing moments. Expect to remain busy like a bee on this challenging day. You may get up in low spirits, and lack energy to do routine tasks. Your work may not get accomplished as expected, and cause dissatisfaction. Visit your doctor – today! Do not squander your money today, and at the same time avoid taking debts, or you may find it difficult repay. However, you may go ahead and apply for loans, if you need to. You will feel lazy today and not in a mood to work. You may tend to escape from your responsibilities. However, Ganesha says it will only hamper your reputation. If you remain committed strictly to your profession now, half of the job will get done and you may need to work less later, says Ganesha.

Remember that actions always speak louder than words. You will, in all probability, finish your work that has been seeking your attention for long now. You shall also successfully bring continuing disputes to the table and resolve them logically. An entertaining evening awaits you as you may go for a movie with your partner or friends. You may grab a wonderful chance to spend the night with someone special. You will feel happy when you please your sweetheart with your fun. Today your energy level may dip, and adversely affect your performance in office. This indicates that you deserve a break from your tight work schedule. Expend more time with your parents, spouse and kids. They will be more than happy. Mostly, the day is in your favour for financial matters. You should avoid spending heavily on travel plans, feels Ganesha, as it may burn a big hole in your pocket. Your mind seems to be brimming with fresh and creative ideas and therefore you will excel in the tasks you perform. Since you will be eager to take initiatives, work pressure will pile up, says Ganesha. You have to be confident under tremendous pressure.

Your hands are full with plenty of projects and assignments. Finish them off as soon as you can and spend rest of the day refreshing your mind. Communicating with people of all walks of life will make you enhance your horizon of knowledge, feels Ganesha. Talking about personal life, you will feel free to conduct yourself as per your wish. Your life partner will depend on you and you tend to worry about your future. You will let your partner indulge in a joint decision-making to root out any difference in opinions or disagreements. A stable harmonious family life is what you love to see, feels Ganesha. You are not at your best energy level today. You must take rest. This is good day for taking indoor activities like watching movies, reading books. You should not pay attention to things which can be done later. You should relax and recharge yourself. Today you will be very interested in spending money on your vehicle or house. You should be open-minded and not conservative if you really want to see value of money spent behind vehicle or house. You should work on daily activities today and leave the handling of important meetings to your teammates. Your objective is to ensure smooth functioning of the current project. You will be confident in your tasks. Good thing is that you will not be in a hurry since you believe in steady progress.

Things have become stagnant but it fails to frustrate your spirit. Slow and steady wins the race and it seems you have imbibed it very well. You will be able to seize opportunities coming your way and march ahead on your path. Financially, you will be on a stable ground, says Ganesha. Your optimistic attitude is likely to impress your beloved and promises you a rejuvenated love life. Your enthusiastic mindset will create a positive aura around your loved one. You will have a happy and harmonious evening with your sweetheart, foresees Ganesha. Your mind will be very active. You will be applying logic to things. Try to be flexible in your thinking because if you try to resist things/thoughts, your energy will be wasted. You must remain open-minded in your approach. This is not a great day for financial gains. Stick to routine practices and do not expect much from anything. Tendency to take risks would be very high today, so you must not get into risky investments. Creativity will encourage you to achieve even complexities in professional life. With your mind brimming with new ideas, you should find it easy to handle creative tasks. Once the creative ideas are effectively implemented, you will invest much time in decoding complex technical issues.

You need to tread cautiously today when it comes to matters related to business. Do not make any decisions in haste, or it could come back to haunt you at a later date. All financial dealings will need to be carefully monitored. Do not indulge in speculative activities or undue risk taking. A little consideration now will save you a lot of trouble later, says Ganesha. Misunderstanding is on the cards, foresees Ganesha. Differences of opinions are likely to misguide you. Try to be faithful to your sweetheart and clear out all issues obstructing your way to a blissful relationship, suggest Ganesha. You may engage in fun activities with your lover. Today you should avoid getting frustrated by small small things. Disappointments, rejections or incomplete tasks may make you feel upset emotionally. You must not ‘give up’ and keep trying for things that you wish to achieve. Try to be happy and balanced. Today is good day for money matters. You will be able to see the worth of your invested money. You may also feel proud of what you have in your bank account or in terms of assets. It’s the best time to request for an appraisal, though it may come after some time. You may occupy with some busy routines as you will work closely with your teammates and seniors. Professional life seems to be quite tough for you as you may have to take some tough decisions.
